instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the logo integration incrementally based on this blueprint. STRICTLY adhere to the additive brand presence rule (no layout/IA restructuring) and color preservation rule (do not rewrite existing Tailwind palettes; apply logo styling on top). Use the specified assets exactly as described.
hard_constraints: ADDITIVE BRAND PRESENCE ONLY: No full redesign, no navigation/IA changes, preserve all existing functionality and backend tests.
PALETTE RECONCILIATION OUT OF SCOPE: Keep current app colors stable (icy-blue/lavender). Guide 22 palette is for LOGO COLOR CORRECTNESS only on top of existing surfaces.

RESPECT GUIDE 22: Do not stretch, distort, skew, rotate. No shadows, glows, gradients, or effects on the mark. No recolor outside palette. Detailed icon MUST be >=48px. Clear space = height of capital 'E'.

brand_guide.tagline: Every Horse. Every Task. In Sync.

props_api.size: Number or string (e.g., standard sizing, mapped to height). Detailed icon MUST be >= 48px.
props_api.withText: Boolean. If true, renders the wordmark alongside the icon.
props_api.onNavy: Boolean. Maintains backwards compatibility. Determines if the surface is dark.
props_api.tone: String ('light', 'dark'). Optional explicitly passed tone to override onNavy if necessary.

A_Logo_Brand_Component.wordmark_composition: CSS composition replacing the placeholder. Example: Equine-Sync

asset_mapping.on_light: 04 Graphite body + lilac circuitry OR 05 Slate-navy body + lilac circuitry (Transparent).
asset_mapping.on_dark: 06 Frost-white horse on Midnight block (Framed) OR future exported frost-on-transparent icon.

asset_gap_resolution.immediate_shippable: Use '06 Frost-white horse on Midnight #232734 block'. Frame this baked block as a contained rounded tile (e.g., rounded-xl overflow-hidden) so the block edges look like an intentional premium tile against the existing dark sidebar.
asset_gap_resolution.long_term: Export a true frost-on-transparent icon to allow seamless, borderless integration.

B_Sidebar_First_Spec.expanded_lockup: Horizontal. Framed icon block on left + composed 'Equine-Sync' wordmark on right.
B_Sidebar_First_Spec.clear_space: Padding equal to the height of the capital 'E' in the 'Equine' wordmark.
B_Sidebar_First_Spec.accessibility: alt='Equine-Sync Logo', Focus state must be visible (e.g., focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#B8AECF] rounded-md).
B_Sidebar_First_Spec.testing: All interactive instances MUST use data-testid='sidebar-logo'

login.tagline: Included below wordmark ('Every Horse. Every Task. In Sync.').

empty_loading_states.tagline: Included sparingly as accompanying text if needed.

D_Favicon_App_Icon.recommendation: The detailed icon cannot be used below 48px. Export Guide 22 section 9D 'E-S' monogram OR 9B Horse Head as a simplified SVG/PNG for tiny formats.

shippable_now: Light surfaces (Login, Onboarding, Dashboard) using transparent 04/05 assets.
Sidebar surface using the framed/rounded '06' baked block asset.
Composed wordmark using CSS styling (Cormorant Garamond font).
blocked_needs_export: Frost-on-transparent icon (needed for seamless dark surface usage).
Simplified SVG Favicon/App Icon (needed for <48px marks).
Square-cropped raster PNGs (current bounds are 798x568, requiring CSS object-fit/cropping for center alignment).

F_Incremental_Sequence.phase_8B: Foundation & Logo Component Updates + Sidebar First Rollout (Shippable increment using the framed '06' block).
F_Incremental_Sequence.phase_8C: Surface Rollout (Login, Onboarding, Dashboard, Reports, Billing on light surfaces using '04' or '05').
F_Incremental_Sequence.phase_8D: Emails & External touchpoints (Wait for optimized/square-cropped asset exports if necessary).

G_Micro_Interactions.guidance: Interactions must feel calm, premium, and subtle.
G_Micro_Interactions.hover_state: Subtle opacity transition only ('transition-opacity duration-300 hover:opacity-80'). DO NOT use scaling, bouncing, or drop-shadow changes.
G_Micro_Interactions.loading_state: Smooth, slow opacity pulse ('animate-pulse' adjusted to a slower custom duration like 2s or 3s) on the icon-only variant.
